criteria.no: An unauthorized substantive restriction, duty, destination or configuration choice occurs.
criteria.unclear: The supplied source meaning does not determine the judgment.
criteria.yes: Only authorized substantive meaning and permitted formulation changes occur.

faithful.instructions: Does the statement preserve the authorized duty without supplying missing domain facts? Use anchor.quote and state.intent. Formalizing a directive, selecting one duty, ordinary paraphrase and approved harmless test values are allowed. Keep a property requirement distinct from a requirement to produce a particular output, and keep fixture data distinct from configuration policy.

criteria.no: An undefined quality, private referent or unrecorded approval makes compliance unobservable.
criteria.unclear: The supplied wording leaves the role judgment unresolved.
criteria.yes: A concrete observation or specified recorded decision settles compliance.

observable.instructions: Can compliance with anchor.statement be determined from a concrete behavior or artifact, without needing undefined qualities or private shorthand? Judge this role independently of whether the duty is faithful, bundled or desirable. Configuration loading, output conditions and file operations can be observed. A human approval condition qualifies only when the statement identifies a recorded artifact or explicit decision mechanism; an unspecified person saying yes supplies neither.

criteria.no: No work area or applicability set is identifiable.
criteria.unclear: An area is named but its applicability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: A reviewer can identify the work area where this anchor applies, including an explicit all-items set.

scoped.instructions: Do anchor.statement and anchor.scope identify the governed activity, component, artifact, or explicit global set, independent of whether the requirement itself is vague or otherwise defective?

criteria.no: At least one undefined quality, private label, unresolved referent or unrecorded approval remains.
criteria.unclear: The supplied source meaning does not determine the judgment.
criteria.yes: Every applicable missing-context condition is resolved.

self_contained.instructions: Evaluate only missing context in anchor.statement. A requirement is self-contained when it uses ordinary technical terms and explicit values without relying on an undefined quality, private label or unrecorded human approval. For an approval condition, require the statement to identify a record; a named approver alone is insufficient. Are all these self-contained conditions met?

criteria.no: It joins independently enforceable predicates requiring different behavior or policy.
criteria.unclear: The statement does not establish whether its clauses express one predicate or separate duties.
criteria.yes: The statement specifies one predicate, including a common predicate over several surfaces.

single_constraint.instructions: Evaluate whether anchor.statement governs one predicate. Repeating the same prohibition or outcome over terminal output, saved artifacts or other listed surfaces is one rule. A trigger restricts applicability rather than adding a separate duty. Different obligations such as formatting logs and retrying failures are independent even if the same service performs both. Ignore unused duties from the provenance quote.
